snapshot.title: Fix space map: dark background, target clicks open mission dialogue, remove stale scanner message
snapshot.description: Space map has multiple issues: (1) background renders white because NebulaSciTheme forwards to light-mode DS palette — needs forced dark colours, (2) no asteroid/planet targets visible, (3) clicking a target navigates away to asteroid preview instead of opening an inline mission-creation dialogue with relevant contractors, (4) free-missions gate needed (lock dialogue for players who haven't reached free-ops stage), (5) the TutorialCoachOverlay fallback 'Navigate to continue your mission.' message should be removed since it gives no actionable info.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Space map background is dark (space-like), not white
Asteroid targets are visible in solar view
Clicking a target opens an inline overlay dialogue — not a scene change
Dialogue shows target info, launch option, and any relevant active contractor missions
Launch option is disabled/locked for players below free-ops stage (mission stage < 4)
Navigate to continue your mission. fallback text is removed from TutorialCoachOverlay

changes.newValue:
See screenshot (image attached in notes).

Issue: the map is white, and has no asteroids or ability to navigate to other solar systems (to see the planet candidates), additionally we need to be able to see a map view of all solar systems.

Clicking on a target in the map should open a dialogue to create a mission to it, and also show any contractor missions that would be relevant. If the user hasn't unlocked free missions, then this should be locked.

Finally, remove the 'navigate to continue your mission' dialogue and add more tags/labels to this ticket.

The main nav bar along the bottom should also show the option to construct new buildings — set up a starter dialogue that's functional, for now it only works for building new things on Earth.
